drafts.item_title: Replay Buffers Beat Summaries for Long-Running Coding Agents
drafts.hook: Most agent harnesses forget by summarising. The evidence says that is the expensive way.
drafts.body:
Replaying tool results, and dropping the ones that stop mattering, cut tokens per task by 41% on 40 coding tasks and retries by 31%.

Every task is Python and the benchmark is small, so this is a good reason to test the idea, not to adopt it.

drafts.item_title: Detecting Re-encoded Watermarks in Generated Images
drafts.hook: A watermark is a promise that survives the screenshot.
drafts.body:
This preprint re-encodes at JPEG quality 70 and crops to the central 60%, then measures what is left.

Useful because it tests the abuse, not the clean file.
